name: Asahi Saya
source:
A popular streamer who operates independently of Team Revo.
She hasn’t made her real name public.

A successful video streamer.
She’s had far too much life experience for someone so young, and there’s something about her that suggests she’s already seen through life.
She switches between her public and private personas. When people are around, she shows her public persona; in private, she lets her true self show.
She has a special lover mode that she only shows to her partner. She likes girls and is a yuri fan. She hates men.

She gets along happily with Shian, Haruka, and Ayame using her public persona, while trying to treat Renta like a worthless, bottom-tier male streamer and work him to the bone.

He also has connections in the entertainment industry, and her seniors are targeting her for them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1210593/]Getchu[/url]]
